signup.title: Create account
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent you a link to verify your account. Open it to be able to log in.

verifyEmail.successBody: Your email was successfully verified. You can now log in.
verifyEmail.errorBody: The link expired or is invalid. Try signing up again to get a new one.

createStore.title: Create your store
createStore.subtitle: Set up the basics now and leave room for richer customization as your brand grows.
createStore.empty: You don't have any stores yet. Create your first one below.
createStore.storesDescription: Jump back into an existing store or start a new branded workspace.
createStore.nameHelp: Use the public name buyers will recognize.
createStore.slugHelp: This becomes part of your storefront URL and can include letters, numbers, and dashes.
createStore.logoHelp: Upload a PNG or JPG to give the store an identity from day one.
createStore.logoUploadingError: The store was created, but the logo upload failed. Open the store and try again in settings.
createStore.brandingDescription: Pick a starting palette for your storefront. You can expand this later.
createStore.previewDescription: A quick look at how your store branding starts to come together.
createStore.futureDescription: Theme sections, typography, and homepage blocks can plug into this setup area next.
createStore.whatsappHelp: Buyers will reach you here to pay. Required.
createStore.genericError: Something went wrong creating the store
createStore.deleteError: Something went wrong deleting the store
createStore.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this store?
